title: Tensor multiplication for concrete Godement models
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $F,G$ module sheaves, and let $A,B,C$ with augmentations $a,b,c$ be ModuleCupGodementModel objects for $F,G,F\otimes G$, respectively [def-sc-module-cup-godement-model]. Assume each also satisfies ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies for the corresponding coefficient sheaf [def-sc-module-cup-godement-codegeneracies]. There exists a cosimplicial morphism $\mu:A\otimes B\to C$ whose degree-zero map, transported from the cosimplicial terms to their extended alternating complexes, satisfies $(a^0\otimes b^0)\,\mu^0=c^0$. The domain uses the canonical degree-zero identification $F[0]^0\otimes G[0]^0=(F\otimes G)[0]^0$. This asserts a pairing for given canonical models, and constructs no models or augmentations.

source.place: Godement resolution, construction preceding Lemma 20.30.1; Banerjee, arXiv:1004.1491, §1.1.4, pp. 15–16.

proof.text: Define beta(F,G):T(F) tensor T(G) to T(F tensor G) by the O(U)-bilinear assignment on each open U that sends a pair of sections to their pointwise tensor at each x in U followed by the stalk tensor map. This commutes with restriction, so the universal property of the sheafified tensor product gives a sheaf morphism. On two germs its x-coordinate is their tensor germ, proving compatibility with the monad unit.

For multiplication compatibility project to each skyscraper coordinate x and evaluate stalk representatives on a common open neighbourhood. Either composite first evaluates the two outer sections at x and then tensors the resulting inner values. Hence the two values agree; stalk representatives and product projections detect the equality. Define beta_0 as the coefficient identity and beta_(k+1) as beta(T^k F,T^k G) followed by T(beta_k). Induction gives commutation with each unit insertion and multiplication insertion.

Transport beta_(n+1) through the term equalities of A,B,C. The model coface equations and the prescribed codegeneracy equations give commutation with the generating simplex maps, so these components define mu. Equality proofs in the two model predicates agree by proof irrelevance. Substitute the three degree-zero augmentation equations into unit compatibility for beta_1 and cancel the term and extension isomorphisms. The two single-object identifications tensor to the single-object identification for F tensor G, giving the required morphism equality. Empty products and zero sheaves satisfy the same formulas.

theorem moduleCup_godement_pairing_for_models (X : Scheme.{u}) (F G : X.Modules)
    (A B C : CosimplicialObject X.Modules)
    (a : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj F ⟶
      (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj A).extend
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
    (b : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj G ⟶
      (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj B).extend
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
    (c : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj (F ⊗ G) ⟶
      (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj C).extend
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
    (hA : ModuleCupGodementModel X F A a)
    (hB : ModuleCupGodementModel X G B b)
    (hC : ModuleCupGodementModel X (F ⊗ G) C c)
    (sA : ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies X F A)
    (sB : ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies X G B)
    (sC : ModuleCupGodementCodegeneracies X (F ⊗ G) C) :
    ∃ μ : CategoryTheory.Monoidal.FunctorCategory.tensorObj
        (C := SimplexCategory) (D := X.Modules) A B ⟶ C,
      ((a.f 0) ⊗ₘ (b.f 0)) ≫
        ((((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj A).extendXIso
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := 0) rfl).hom ⊗ₘ
          (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj B).extendXIso
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := 0) rfl).hom) ≫ μ.app ⦋0⦌ ≫
          (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj C).extendXIso
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := 0) rfl).inv = c.f 0
